title: Quentin and the Horizon
author: Bram Eriksen
blurb: Jonah Vasquez, the caretaker of Earth's abandoned seed vault, has spent fifteen years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise before the jump window closes.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
